title: Bias enhanced electro-photocatalysis on TiO2 nanoporous materials for decomposition of forever chemicals in saltwater
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2025, 4,1024-1034
DOI: 10.1039/D4VA00423J, Paper

Sapanbir S. Thind, Bobby A. Ryane, John. B. Hayden, Ian Chagunda, Mathias Paul, J. Scott McIndoe
In this study, a TiO2-based bias-enhanced photocatalytic system was prepared with the aim of achieving high photocatalytic activity in deionized as well as in saltwater systems.
